t1.text: App shell — icon rail, workspace sessions, chat with capsules, composer

t2.text: Anatomy, motion and the Max-effort moment

p1.text: Paper: every surface is a cut sheet with a hard offset shadow, so depth comes from stacking, not blur. Motion runs on steps() at 8–12 fps like a stop-motion puppet: capsules boil while working, notes drop in, the YOLO and MAX stamps thump down. Sessions are folder tabs over ruled index cards; the selected one is highlighter.

f1.text: Futuristic: a HUD console. Bracket corners, 1 px lines, mono microlabels, one cyan accent with amber for YOLO/Max. Motion is linear and mechanical: a scan line sweeps the working capsule, panels unclip, the reply types itself in. Sessions are a mono manifest; busy rows carry a blinking amber segment.

s1.text: Professional SaaS: white cards on a cool grey ground, 1 px borders, one indigo accent and Inter throughout. Status is a pill (Running, Done, Needs review), workspaces are collapsible groups with a count, and the composer is a bordered card with a segmented effort control. Motion is quiet: 150–250 ms eases, a progress bar across the working capsule, no bounce.

p2.text: Design system: tokens, type, tilt and shadow scales, motion table, icon set and 26 components with live previews live in the Paper Chat design system → https://claude.ai/artifact/M426mkexTAeeJ552WsSWFh. Its tokens are installed on this canvas (Theme menu).

p3.text: Agents page: each agent is an index card with a taped-on 12×12 pixel portrait, the name, the description and one Start a chat button. Click a card to lift it and run a highlighter under the name; Start a chat fills blue and the footer line says which agent was started; search is live. Built from the Paper Chat tokens and pp-* classes.

p4.text: Agent page: a sticky header holds the taped portrait, the name as an editable serif title, Delete (dashed red) and Save (blue, goes kraft-grey when there is nothing to save). Below, index cards for Description, Personality (trait stickers + text), System prompt (ruled, with a token estimate), Preferred model (radio rows), MCP servers (paper switches) and Skills (checkbox rows). Every change marks the page dirty; Save thumps a green sticker down; Delete asks on a kraft note before tearing the agent up.

p5.text: Workspaces list: each workspace is an index card with its colour as a painted spine down the left edge, the name, the linked folders in mono, and one hand-written line (agents · memory facts · Kanban board). Cards with sessions working show a turning amber marker. New session opens a chat with that workspace's folders mounted; search matches names, folders and boards.

p7.text: Kanban list: one index card per board with a rubber-stamped type in the corner (Local, Jira, GitHub), the source in mono, To do / Doing / Done counts as tags, and the workspaces it is tied to as colour chips. Jira and GitHub cards carry a Sync button and a hand-written sync state; local ones say there is nothing to sync. Sync all in the header runs every synced board with a turning arrow. Click a card to open the cork board.

p8.text: Board: a framed cork board. Columns are kraft labels pinned with a red tack; cards are sticky notes in five pastel colours, each a little crooked, with the ticket key, a hand-written title, the workspace swatch, the agent's portrait and when it last moved. Drag a note onto another column to move it (the column lights up); click one to open the ticket drawer on the right: column chips, workspace, agent (change cycles), epic, created, updated, links, description, notes to the agent, history and sessions with a Start a session button. Sync pulls a new note in from Jira; Add card pins a local one that goes to Jira on the next sync. Views: Columns (with Group by epic, which puts hand-written epic labels inside each column) and Dependencies, where notes cluster inside dashed epic regions with kraft labels, each note gets its own tack, and red string sags tack to tack between blocking notes, twine between related ones. Click a note to light up its strings.

p6.text: Workspace page: the header carries the colour chip (pick from six swatches), the editable name, Delete and Save. Left column: Linked folders (mono paths with a git marker, unlink ×, Add a folder), Extra context (ruled, token estimate) and Memory (facts learned by sessions here, pin to keep, × to forget, write your own and press Enter). Right column: Kanban board (a single highlighter row for the linked board with Open board and Unlink; when nothing is linked the row says so and Link a board opens a small floating list of the boards in Kanban), Agents relevant here (checkbox rows with portraits), Skills and MCP servers (paper switches). Delete explains that folders on disk are never touched.
